name: Greywatch
opening: Green fire burns on top of Greywatch Tower for the first time in a hundred years. As you reach the broken gate, a pale knight in rusted armour drifts out of the stones, glowing faintly green. 'At last,' he whispers. 'My relief has come.'
picture: medium shot, (a translucent glowing green ghost knight in rusted armour drifting out of a broken tower gate towards the hero:1.25), (ruined stone watchtower with green fire on top:1.1), stormy sky
background: a ruined stone watchtower with a broken gate on a stormy hill, green fire burning at the top
beats: Find out who lit the green fire
Help the old knight finish his oath
secret: The knight cannot rest until someone finishes his last watch, because something is coming up the valley.
